landed_against.rule: R-17: this slice declares every diff path here and re-captures the baseline it moved.

what_landed: Bard W banks its sourced stock of two shrines rather than one, because the shrine's heal is priced at the cast and the persistent-object exemption does not reach it.
why: The exemption keeps a slot at one banked cast when the module prices the placed object separately, which is true of a turret and not of a shrine: the support events show the heal at the cast instants, so the cast is the packet.
Twenty seconds at full uptime: shrines at 0.25s and 0.5s, the cached inter-cast gap, then one at 18.5s on the recharge, where before there were two in the window.
Exactly one leaf moves, W/charge_pool from absent to 2, because the pool is newly published rather than newly different. No damage leaf moves and no coupled leaf moves: no coupled roster holds Bard.

Bard's mana ledger now shows five spends with the last REFUSED, since 60 + 70 + 70 + 100 spends the whole 300 pool. That is the account declining a cast rather than overdrawing, and no damage is priced for the refused cast.
